name: What is the process for getting my railing repaired?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for getting my railing repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our railing repair process typically begins with an initial consultation and on-site assessment to evaluate the damage and determine the best course of action. We then provide a detailed estimate outlining the scope of work and associated costs. Once approved, we schedule the repair, procure necessary materials, and perform the work with minimal disruption. Upon completion, we conduct a final inspection to ensure satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an on-site assessment, detailed estimate, scheduling, repair, and final inspection.
